parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

> You can query data within the last 7 days.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the callback was successful. Valid values:
- success: The callback was successful.
- failed: The callback failed.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type of the recording for which to query callback records. Valid values:

- oss: recorded to OSS

- vod: recorded to ApsaraVideo VOD

- all: queries callback records for all storage types
